page.title: Anchor — Plan the day. Learn what moved it.
page.description: A private day planner and focus timer for Mac, iPhone and Apple Watch.

hero.title:
Plan the day.
*Learn what moved it.*
hero.lede: A private day planner and focus timer for people moving between Mac, iPhone and Apple Watch who want to learn why the day they lived differed from the plan.

secondary.label: See iPhone and Watch beta status ›

hero.note: Invite-only TestFlight and notarized Mac beta. Requires macOS 26 or later.

screen.alt: Anchor Today on iPhone: draw the day, build your usual week, and give the day one anchor

sections.title: The gap is *the useful part.*
sections.lede: Anchor schedules the day, protects the current block, captures what changed, and gives that evidence back when you plan tomorrow.

rows.title: Plan
rows.body: Today shows the day as a chronological rail, keeps gaps visible, and distinguishes a one-off adjustment from a change to the usual week.

rows.title: Focus
rows.body: Anchor offers the current or next scheduled block, keeps time from the wall clock, and makes interruption capture immediate.

rows.title: Capture
rows.body: Coming back captures the interruption. “Nothing, just a break” stays one key away.

rows.title: History
rows.body: Deliberate changes, internal pulls, external interruptions, human needs, estimation errors, and unknown gaps stay distinct.

sections.title: Your notes are not *product telemetry.*
sections.lede: Full Anchor data stays local or in your private iCloud database. Optional Hub sync sends only finished-session summaries and never distraction notes, plans, or behavior selections.

aside.title: Anchor fits if
aside.body: you want one place to schedule the day, focus on the present block, and learn why the plan changed.

aside.title: It is not
aside.body: a website blocker, a social productivity feed, or a moral score for how closely you followed a plan.

items.a: No. Anchor is fully usable without one. A Significant Hobbies Hub account is optional and only adds finished-session summary visibility.

items.q: Is it on the App Store?
items.a: Not yet. This site will not show Apple’s App Store badge until a live apps.apple.com page exists.

items.q: Can I download the Mac app?
items.a: Yes. The Mac beta is Developer ID signed, hardened, notarized by Apple, and requires macOS 26 or later.

closing.title:
Protect the present.
*Adapt tomorrow.*
closing.note: Invite-only TestFlight and notarized Mac beta. Not listed on the App Store yet.

footer.summary: A private day planner and focus timer, not a blocker.
